Lacework was acquired by Fortinet and is now branded as Lacework FortiCNAPP. The SLA document exists but specific uptime percentages and credit tiers are not publicly accessible. Service credits are available only to Premium (FortiCare Elite) support tier customers. Contact Fortinet/Lacework directly for current SLA terms.
